verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI-style docs) for Hoppscotch itself — the openapi.json/swagger probe explicitly returned 404s across all candidate paths, and while llms.txt exists it is only a static docs index, not a runnable example explorer. The Embed feature lets users embed a Hoppscotch instance in a page, but that is about sharing a request UI, not exposing an interactive API reference with runnable examples for AI-native exploration.
